title: ML эксперименты
summary: A personal collection of Kaggle machine-learning experiment notebooks and utilities, including a Kaggle housing-prices competition project. It includes utility scripts (utils/synth_generator_CTGAN.py, utils/syth_generator_gaussian.py) that instantiate and fit SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, using metadata schemas, to generate synthetic tabular data for augmentation.
needs: Industry domain unclear beyond generic Kaggle ML experiments; SDV usage appears general-purpose rather than tied to a specific dataset domain.
